status: Native-only feasibility probe; not enabled in production. Modest observed benefit does not close frame-budget or cross-target interaction acceptance.
measurement_context: Chronological order B,C,C,C,B,B. Three independent process runs per variant; not randomized paired trials. No concurrent Cargo validation during any measurement; source fixed within each run. Original paired-grid-v1 neutral fixture, 35% zoom and 1440x900 CPU widget/tessellation viewport, twenty warm samples per size per process. First frames retained separately. All reports preserve zero cold routing fallbacks and existing route outcome assertions. No browser, pointer-driven moving/release frames, native application, GPU execution or presentation timing. Production implementation restored before final regression additions.
candidate: At zoom <0.6 (no inline controls), only fully clipped-in nodes whose near-hit-expanded target bounds are isolated from every other node qualify; transformed layers, invalid radius and geometry/topology changes between allocation and drawing fall back. Reconstruct actual initial per-socket rank from the allocation layout. Walk final base/header/toggle/socket order and omit move_to_top only if no earlier potentially competing target currently ranks higher. Refresh every widget, with the original IDs, senses and focus-call order. Earlier successful native response regressions plus exhaustive permutations of five abstract target ranks cover the prototype; they do not prove every platform/interaction combination.
retained_regressions: Tab and Shift-Tab must keep clipped targets in their original allocation order; active header capture must survive fully clipped geometry and release. Candidate production changes are not retained.
